tracks.title: Foundations
tracks.summary: Invariants and premises carried into the programme.

nodes.title: Offline integration exists and is required.

Approximate Bayesian contextual inference is architecturally impossible to co-compute with online encoding: prior construction (schema formation -- which context distinctions are structurally relevant) must precede posterior inference (attribution -- which evidence belongs to which context slot); a system attempting both online produces a degenerate prior that makes attribution uninformative regardless of training duration.
Cognition is predictive, iterative, and multi-timescale.
Representation and regulation are strictly separated.
harm_evaluator_bounded_by_z_harm_differentiation
A self is an operational prerequisite for responsible agency.
Irreducible uncertainty is an epistemological constraint that cannot be engineered away.
An external world is a structural prerequisite for grounded representation.
Language emerges as functional self-representation, not a bolt-on.
Harm to others contributes via mirror modelling, not symbolic rules.
Chronic harm-dominated environments produce a self-maintaining depressive attractor: z_goal seeding failure, terrain collapse, and HABIT/PLANNED behavioural equivalence.
Goal-directed behaviour in adversive environments requires a tonic regulatory system maintaining benefit orientation across terrain, transduction, and maintenance stages.
Agency is required; passive predictors are not REE.

Evaluation channels are evidence-producing boundaries, not world-state affordances: no agentic subsystem -- including an AI assistant developing REE -- may update architectural confidence directly from a performance score without provenance, review, and governance mediation. World feedback, evidence feedback, and governance feedback are distinct typed signal classes that must remain non-collapsible.

Sleep phase architecture is regulated by three distinct drives -- circadian timing, homeostatic synaptic pressure, and a learning/model-update demand drive proportional to daily prediction error accumulation (Model Error Load, MEL) -- and only the third drive determines whether the overnight update phase is sufficient for the error burden generated during waking.
e1_e2_e3_maturational_sequence_necessity

Signal-structure temporal decoupling: any signal that is BOTH self-extinguishing (its magnitude is coupled to its own success and therefore necessarily fades as what it bootstraps succeeds) AND load-bearing (the structure it establishes must persist after the signal fades) necessarily requires either a crystallization mechanism (LOCK -- the structure is rendered plasticity-resistant) or a handoff mechanism (a durable, non-extinguishing signal assumes maintenance of the structure before the establishing signal vanishes). Absent both, the structure decays and the acquisition is lost. The lock/handoff disjunction is exhaustive: no third resolution exists.
world_goal_evaluator_bounded_by_z_world_differentiation

Developmental hardening should be substrate-specific: social cognition, goal representation, and epistemic-ethical substrates should retain elevated plasticity throughout adulthood (selective neoteny), while procedural and motor substrates can fully harden.
Benefit terrain collapse creates a closed negative feedback loop (reduced exploration -> reduced benefit exposure -> continued sub-threshold seeding) predicting chronicity.
Cross-species signal legibility evidences that stereotyped signals are functionally specific (causally generated), not socially conventional.
proxy_tethering_constraint
V(t): Verisimilitude is the precision-weighted, phase-aligned, hierarchical correspondence between ascending sensory-constrained and descending model-based signals.
Control plane routes precision and modes.
Hippocampal systems store and replay paths through residue-field terrain.
E3 selects and commits trajectories.
Hippocampus generates explicit rollouts and post-commitment viability mapping.
E1 is the persistent predictive substrate.
Three BG-like cortico-striatal loops require distinct learning channels.
Residue is persistent latent-space curvature; hippocampal paths form a cognitive map.
REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.
E2 is the fast forward predictor of affordances.
Commit-boundary token reclassifies pre-commit vs post-commit error routing.

The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).
Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.
Sensory prediction error, motor-sensory error, and harm/goal error are incommensurable and cannot be collapsed.

What is the minimal signal architecture for play frame maintenance: is a single bilateral open/close tag sufficient, or does ongoing signal exchange (a continuous play-face equivalent) need to be sustained throughout the episode?
Legacy external representation-reference contract (inputs, outputs, knobs, failure gates).

Dopaminergic modulation of hippocampal place coding at reward-associated locations produces representational expansion (higher information density, finer spatial resolution, more stable place fields), and this expansion -- not an explicit positive valence gradient -- is the mechanism by which approach valence enters hippocampal terrain.

What event counts as V3 closure for the purpose of the version-transition artefact gate (GOV-V3FREEZE-1) and the construction-opacity repayment boundary (GOV-OPACITY-1)? Candidate options: strict green board, governance acceptance, or an additional reproducibility check.
Slow target-anchor dynamics stabilize E1/E2 representations via functional rate separation.
Legacy: resolved in favor of valence/mu-kappa separation with calibration follow-up.
Legacy: resolved via bounded care-override policy with hard catastrophic other-harm veto.
E3 uses coordinated tri-loop gating (motor, cognitive-set, motivational) as the pre-commit eligibility layer.
z_beta leakage: attributed other-model affective state activates self z_beta directly, not via inference.

E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.

Progressive sleep deprivation or neurodegeneration causes staged failure of the offline consolidation pipeline in reverse dependency order: precision recalibration (MECH-123/Phase 4) degrades first, producing early MCI features; slot-filling (MECH-121/Phase 2-3) next, producing the classic early Alzheimer's episodic profile (intact remote, absent new); slot-formation (MECH-120/Phase 1-2) last, producing middle-stage contextual identity loss and schema destabilisation; global context collapse last.
Stereotyped behavioral signals are causal externalizations of specific internal functional states, making them cross-architecturally legible without learned convention.

The specific staged cognitive decline profile of Alzheimer's disease -- early precision/confidence loss, then episodic memory failure, then contextual identity loss, then global disorientation -- follows the reverse of the sleep phase dependency ordering and is not explained by diffuse amyloid damage alone, which predicts uniform degradation rather than a staged profile.
Basal ganglia perform dopaminergic gain/threshold setting on hippocampal attractor dynamics.
Serotonin as hippocampal map geometry parameter (rollout depth, distal value weighting) — conflict with MECH-006, pending adjudication.
Commit token must include a cancel-window-open flag supported by a top-down suppressive pathway from dFMC/pre-SMA to premotor cortex that can veto the transition before execution lock-in.
Psychosis is a precision-weighting failure where prior beliefs persistently dominate sensory evidence; the generative model becomes self-sealing and sensory update is suppressed.

tracks.title: Substrate
tracks.summary: Implementation and test-bed work that makes a question testable.

nodes.title: z_gamma split into z_self (E2 motor-sensory domain) and z_world (E3/Hippocampus domain).
L-space is a multi-timescale latent stack.
Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.
Love as long-horizon care-investment is a structurally coherent agent disposition, not an add-on sentiment.
Self-impact attribution and responsibility flow are required.
Language is a symbolic mediation and coordination layer.
Action objects as hippocampal map backbone, enabling long-horizon planning beyond step-level trajectories.
HARM stream is a dedicated sensory pathway separate from z_world processing.

z_harm_a encodes affective surprise (precision-weighted PE), not raw accumulated harm state. The affective stream training target is the mismatch between predicted and actual harm accumulation, making E3 urgency respond to unexpectedness of threat, not just magnitude.
ReafferencePredictor provides perspective-corrected world latent by subtracting self-caused sensory change.
LatentStack EMA alpha for z_world must be >= 0.9 to preserve event responsiveness.
Self-attribution via counterfactual E2: causal signature = E2(z_t, a_actual) minus E2(z_t, a_counterfactual).

Conflict-graded near-tie lever sufficiency: a hyperdirect-STN-like conflict-graded shortlist / commit-temperature lever (k = f(top-F gap); T = f(top-F gap)) is SUFFICIENT to lift committed-action-class entropy strict-above both collapsed-proposer and gap-blind controls -- gap-CONCENTRATED (the lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) -- WITHOUT reducing F's E3 variance share. I.e. F can keep monopolising selection variance and conversion is still recovered by widening/hotting only at near-ties.
CEM-based trajectory search belongs in HippocampalModule, not E2.
E1 associative prior must be wired into HippocampalModule for terrain-informed rollout search.

Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.

Play mode boundary requires a co-maintained context tag held by both agent and environment; agent-internal tagging alone is insufficient and unilateral play assertion without mutual signal is manipulation.

vmPFC is the substrate that converts stored affective, normative, and residue content -- prior outcome history, social and identity constraints, learned value associations, and safety memories -- into active components of the navigable state used by E3 during trajectory evaluation.

An agent that only avoids harm but cannot sustain prospective goal-directed motivation cannot exercise genuine agency; goal maintenance is a necessary co-condition for ethical agency alongside harm-avoidance.

REE architecture enables but does not guarantee ethical development; without a developmental phase in which the agent experiences love from caregivers and internalises the belief that it is loveable, the architectural capacity for ethics (INV-025-029) may resolve to survival, domination, or indifference instead.
Play mode operates by substituting synthetic z_goal and z_harm signals while permitting full learning flow through E3/E2/E1 as if signals were real.

Dementia is computationally a progressive failure of contextual attribution rather than primarily a memory storage failure: episodic memory loss is downstream of progressive collapse of the offline consolidation pipeline that maintains the context attribution scaffold.

Any pharmacological agent that disrupts sleep architecture produces equivalent attribution pipeline degradation to behavioral sleep deprivation, proportional to which phase(s) are disrupted and the duration of exposure -- the pipeline is mechanism-agnostic and responds only to phase fidelity.
Play is a structurally necessary behavioral mode: without a bounded low-stakes learning context, strategy acquisition requires accepting real harm risk or forgoing novel exploration entirely.

The biological NREM-then-REM sleep phase sequence is the correct computational order, derivable from the logical dependencies between the failure modes each phase addresses; this ordering is not a contingent biological fact but an engineering necessity, and it serves directly as the V4 rewiring specification: each phase specifies what structural change the REE substrate requires to address its failure mode.

tracks.title: Evidence
tracks.summary: V3 claims being exposed to an experimental verdict.

nodes.title: Goal-directed behavior requires homeostatic drive modulation: z_goal seeding demands drive-scaled benefit signals.
BG-level beta oscillations gate E3-to-action-selection propagation, not E3 internal updating.
Quiescent E3 heartbeat cycles trigger hippocampal SWR-equivalent replay for viability map consolidation.
E1 updates are batched into theta-cycle summaries before reaching E3 (cross-frequency temporal packaging).

E3 maintains a structured latent goal representation (positive attractor in z_goal sub-space, measurable as z_goal_norm > 0) distinct from harm avoidance, enabling hippocampal terrain navigation toward goal states.

E1 must expose a z_world-only ContextMemory query path that produces two downstream signals: an action-affordance bias for E2 (MECH-151) and a terrain precision weight for E3 harm/goal scoring (MECH-152); the existing bulk generate_prior() path is insufficient because it blends z_self and z_world and produces no cue-specific modulation.

Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.

Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]

PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

V_s residual schema-staleness accumulator: a region-indexed scalar that integrates broadcast invalidation events (MECH-287) with attribution_weight credit assignment over the active anchor set, leaks slowly, and is read by both online anchor-reset (MECH-269 hysteresis check, waking) and sleep-consolidation priority (MECH-285, offline). Distinct from generic prediction error (which operates on latent values and updates online via gradient): MECH-284 is region-indexed, accumulates across events, and exposes a dual read-out (online + offline). Refined 2026-04-22 from sleep-only formulation to dual-readout formulation after V3-EXQ-475 demonstrated that an agent trapped in a stale anchor needs an online consumer of the staleness signal -- MECH-285 sleep-only readout cannot rescue the agent during waking. Saturated map produces over-attention to schema revision (anxiety-analog); absent map produces schema rigidity (V3-EXQ-475 phenotype: 5-6 PAG releases per seed but never integrate to anchor invalidation -> 1000/1000 freeze-active steps).

Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).

behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.
SD-003 counterfactual attribution requires a dedicated harm forward model E2_harm_s(z_harm_s, action) -> z_harm_s_next operating within the sensory-discriminative harm stream.

Hippocampal replay is surprise-gated and generative: episodes with high unexplained prediction error are prioritized, replayed with counterfactual variations via E2, and deprioritized only when forward models can account for the surprise.

Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.
Amygdala analogue as BLA + CeA salience stage between z_harm_a and the cingulate/hippocampus — two peer non-trainable arithmetic modules owning the MECH-046 and MECH-074a-d behaviours.
The wanting signal (goal-distance scoring via z_goal_latent) and the liking signal (benefit_eval_head receipt predictor) are functionally dissociable in trajectory scoring.

pACC-autonomic coupling: module connecting affective-pain stream (z_harm_a) to valence/drive update pathway. Provides the affective-pain -> autonomic/visceral coupling that Vogt 2005 and Craig 2009 locate in perigenual/subgenual ACC.

Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.
The NREM sub-phase of offline mode replays recent episodic content via SWR-equivalent sequences, transferring episodic traces from E3/hippocampal buffer to E1/neocortical schematic representation.

Inactive or strained anchors whose preserved goal payload still matches the current goal form a ranked ghost-goal bank; priority scales with wanting, goal-match, staleness, and recoverability rather than with staleness alone.

F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.
E3 requires a structured latent goal representation (positive attractor in z_world or z_goal sub-space) distinct from harm avoidance.

Self-attribution is implemented by a forward-model comparator: for any reafferent latent stream z_x with an efference-copy-driven forward model E2_x, the residual (z_x_observed - E2_x(z_x_{t-1}, a_actual)) is the agency signal on that stream.

Hippocampal map nodes must store an explicit 4-component valence vector (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise) updated incrementally per visit; replay prioritisation is weighted by drive-state-gated valence relevance.

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063 -- brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18, this parenthetical is stale as of registration 2026-05-08). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, strong reading: a distributed CandidateRule field with tolerance-gated availability, hippocampal-rollout-eligibility shaping, structured per-action evidence-trace records, and waking-vs-sleep refinement asymmetry. The biology-faithful form of the rule-apprehension layer, formalising the 2026-05-04 thought-intake on tolerance-gated rule apprehension (PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2508061123). Brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18; V3-tractable design landed 2026-06-04 (docs/architecture/arc_063_candidate_rule_field.md). Only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3); the sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry is V3 (sleep rescoped to V3 2026-04-20; reuses the MECH-272/273/285 sleep cluster) and is a V3 follow-on within ARC-063, NOT V4. Persistent flag for governance: this slot is expected to be needed if ARC-062 (weak reading) fails or proves insufficient at scale, AND independently as the architectural commitment that supports moral-residue attribution to the rule-field, sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry, and clinically-realistic failure modes (trauma schemas, paranoid rule fields, depressive rollout constraint).
The SWS sub-phase of offline mode performs global attractor flattening and residue field denoising (synaptic homeostasis analog), pruning weak noisy traces and restoring signal-to-noise ratio.

nodes.title: Three BG-like loops operate at characteristic thalamic heartbeat rates.

Candidate-differentiated affect vector: for proto-affect to carve behaviour it must carry per-candidate (cross-candidate) range, not merely per-tick magnitude. Each E3 candidate trajectory carries a multi-channel affect vector (curiosity / safety / harm-sensory / harm-affective / effort / relief / blocked-agency) so the same world-state can support different candidate rankings (approach / inspect / retreat / persist / retry / rest / reorient) under different internal pressures. A scalar added equally to all K candidates cannot change an argmax; only a per-candidate-differentiated contribution can.

Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

Type-encoder produces a category-prototype feature vector that is written into the AnchorSet alongside z_world, so anchors can be queried by type-key as well as location-key. The type-encoder uses the same input substrate as the existing instance-encoder but produces a different (regularity-extracted) representation, mirroring the trisynaptic-vs-monosynaptic complementary-learning architecture within hippocampus.

REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

Externalised Default Mode Operation: play instantiates DMN functions (self-reference, autobiographical memory, social imagination, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) externally -- pushed outward into objects, roles, movement, spoken narration, and temporary as-if worlds -- as the developmental precursor to the internal DMN, compressing into internal generative modelling over development.
Temporoparietal junction (TPJ) acts as agency-detection comparator distinguishing self-caused from other-caused change.

Belief-state hypothesis set: when observations are ambiguous or incomplete, REE maintains a bounded set of competing latent-state hypotheses, each carrying confidence/precision, predicted transitions, goal/antigoal relations, and uncertainty; E3 evaluates candidate trajectories over the hypothesis set rather than over a single collapsed state.

Ephaptic/oscillatory field-level coherence functions as a fast, non-synaptic CONTENT-AGGREGATION mechanism -- not merely the confidence/eligibility readout MECH-270 already covers -- synthesising distributed oscillatory information (amplitude, phase, relative phase, frequency, synchrony, cross-frequency relationships) into the temporally-coherent 'actionable now' state that seeds hippocampal proposal generation. The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.

Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries. Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.
